name: Password Sign-In Rejected
summary: A user submits password credentials that are not accepted and no authenticated session is established. Invalid-password and unknown-account outcomes share the same canonical rejected user experience while retaining distinct internal audit evidence.
finalOutcome: No authenticated session is established and the user receives a non-enumerating rejected sign-in experience while internal evidence may distinguish invalid credentials from an unknown account.

sourceReferences.note: PasswordSignInAsync distinguishes unknown-account and invalid-credential branches internally, but both leave the caller unauthenticated.
Integration coverage separately proves user-not-found and invalid-credential audit trails.
Behavior review intentionally groups unknown account and invalid password under one canonical rejected outcome to avoid making account enumeration part of the user-facing auth model.
